summary: Reproduced the SGLang-side collision precondition: MooncakeStore forwarded the same configured ssd_offload_path to every embedded client, while HiCacheController computed but did not retain the DP rank. The correction carries dp_rank in HiCacheStorageConfig and passes each configured client a created rank_<dp>_<tp>_<pp> subdirectory. A regression verifies DP-attention clients with identical local TP rank are isolated, with independent TP/PP and unset-path boundary cases.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression showed HiCacheStorageConfig did not accept dp_rank, preventing distinct DP-attention client identities; raw output is reports/j-d39e095a1905/raw/regression-before.txt.

Three focused cases passed: DP ranks with tp_rank=0 received distinct rank_<dp>_0_0 directories, TP/PP ranks were independently distinct, and an unset SSD path was not forwarded; raw output is reports/j-d39e095a1905/raw/regression-after.txt.
Fourteen adjacent Mooncake and new path-isolation unit tests passed; raw output is reports/j-d39e095a1905/raw/mooncake-unit-suite.txt.
Repository formatting, lint, spelling, AST, test-registration, and other applicable pre-commit checks passed; raw output is reports/j-d39e095a1905/raw/pre-commit.txt.

gpu_execution.evidence: The corrected behavior is CPU-side rank configuration, directory creation, and keyword forwarding; no GPU kernel or model execution is involved in the regression.

remaining_limitations: The DeepSeek-V4-Flash weights and reported TP8 multi-rank Mooncake bucket deployment were not available, so silent KV byte corruption under the full production workload was not reproduced.
Tests use the actual SGLang MooncakeStore implementation with a deterministic fake Mooncake client; they validate client path isolation, not Mooncake bucket I/O or restart re-adoption semantics.
No GPU claim is made, and this result does not qualify model architecture behavior, semantic accuracy, or distributed recovery.
